why_use_section.title: Why Teams Use Jotform
why_use_section.subtitle: Fast form building, practical automation, and enough flexibility for real business operations.
paragraphs: Jotform is a strong fit when teams need to move from scattered messages, manual spreadsheets, and unstructured requests into clean digital intake flows. Forms can be built quickly, branded clearly, and shared through links or embedded on existing pages.

The platform goes beyond basic forms with payments, conditional logic, e-signatures, generated PDFs, tables, approvals, and integrations. Devisgon helps shape those pieces into a workflow that captures the right data and hands it to the right people or systems.
